newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank chief says hostile takeover impossible.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank chief says hostile takeover impossible.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank AG chairman Albrecht Schmidt said on Thursday that he believed an unfriendly takeover of a German bank was impossible.
Asked about continued speculation about consolidation in the German banking sector, Schmidt said that the overcrowded German banking industry supported the case for consolidation.
"But I consider an unfriendly takeover of a bank to be impossible," he said.
Schmidt said that a key aspect of banking was profile and reputation and that this would be destroyed if a hostile takeover took place.
He also said that equity capital regulations for German banks made a hostile takeover almost impossible.
"So much capital is destroyed in an unfriendly take over, it is fatal."
Vereinsbank has been at the centre of takeover speculation since market leader Deutsche Bank AG last year said it had build up a 5.2 percent stake in its Bavarian rival.
Vereinsbank has always insisted that it plans to remain independent.
